title: Why GenAI-Driven Real Estate Strategies Demand High-Quality Data & Platforms like VergeSense
summary: GenAI in CRE thrives on integrated, large-scale data. Discover why platforms like VergeSense optimize portfolio strategy via unified occupancy insights.
body_markdown:
By: Harvard Business Review


This HBR‑sponsored article examines how generative AI is transforming commercial real estate decision-making—but only when fueled by robust, integrated data. VergeSense is named among emerging platforms that enable enterprises to leverage billions of occupancy data points through natural language interfaces, unifying sensor, WiFi, booking, and badge streams to power smarter portfolio strategy and optimization.


[Read More](https://hbr.org/sponsored/2024/07/why-better-genai-driven-real-estate-decisions-stem-from-better-data-sets)
